description: Look up many identifiers at once before shipping code: model ids, API endpoints (/v1/assistants), MCP tool names, SDK methods or field names. For each one, a one line answer and the ids of matching records, plus the records themselves. A record scoped to some code (for example only repos that depend on a given SDK major version) is returned with that scope spelled out, never as an unconditional hit. Max 100 identifiers.

identifiers.description: Identifiers as they appear in code

name: check_identifiers

date_passed.description: True when the key date is today or earlier (UTC)

scope.description: Empty when the record applies to every caller; otherwise where it applies

title: Check many identifiers
